cards.ex: We need a substantial amount of funding to complete this project successfully.
cards.exUz: Biz bu loyihani muvaffaqiyatli yakunlash uchun ancha katta miqdorda mablag'ga muhtojmiz.
cards.uzDef: Ancha katta bo'lgan miqdor; sezilarli darajada ko'p.

cards.ex: The artist paid attention to every minute detail in the painting.
cards.exUz: Rassom rasmning har bir juda kichik tafsilotiga e'tibor qaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kichik va muhim bo'lgan tafsilot.

cards.ex: The island is roughly the size of Manhattan.
cards.exUz: Orol taxminan Manhattan kattaligida.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning kattaligi bilan taxminan bir xil.

cards.ex: The company's market share expanded exponentially after the new product launch.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning bozor ulushi yangi mahsulot ishga tushirilgandan so'ng juda tez kengaydi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va katta hajmda o'sish yoki kengayish.

cards.ex: His explanation doesn't really hold water; I think he's hiding something.
cards.exUz: Uning izohi unchalik ishonchli emas; menimcha, u nimadirni yashiryapti.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatga yaqin bo'lmoq, tekshiruvga bardosh berish.

cards.ex: There might be a grain of truth in what he says, but I doubt it.
cards.exUz: Uning gapida haqiqat zarrasi bo'lishi mumkin, lekin men bunga shubha qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Ozroq bo'lsa ham haqiqat mavjudligi.

cards.ex: Let me just explain the plan in broad strokes; we can discuss the details later.
cards.exUz: Keling, men sizga reja haqida umumiy qilib aytib beray, tafsilotlarni keyin muhokama qilishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Barcha tafsilotlarni aytmasdan, umumiy ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: Don't get bogged down in trivial matters; focus on the big picture.
cards.exUz: Arzimagan narsalarga chalg'imang; asosiy maqsadga e'tibor qarating.
cards.uzDef: Muhim bo'lmagan, kichik masalalar.

cards.ex: She is a towering figure in the world of environmental activism.
cards.exUz: U atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish faoliyati olamida ulkan shaxsdir.
cards.uzDef: Mashhur, ta'sirli va hurmatga sazovor shaxs.

cards.ex: We're experiencing diminishing returns from our marketing campaign; it's time to try something new.
cards.exUz: Biz marketing kampaniyamizdan kamayuvchi foyda olyapmiz; yangi narsani sinab ko'rish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Sarflangan harakat ortishi bilan foydaning kamayishi.

cards.ex: The new regulations only paper over the cracks in the system; they don't address the root cause.
cards.exUz: Yangi qoidalar tizimdagi muammoni vaqtincha yashiradi, uning asosiy sababiga to'xtalmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni vaqtincha yashirish, yechim topmaslik.

cards.ex: The money we raised is just a drop in the bucket compared to what's needed.
cards.exUz: Biz yig'gan pul kerak bo'lgan narsaga nisbatan dengizdan bir tomchi xolos.
cards.uzDef: Katta narsaning juda kichik bir qismi.

cards.ex: The building had a distinctive wedge-shaped design.
cards.exUz: Binoning o'ziga xos pona shaklidagi dizayni bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Pona shakliga ega bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: In the grand scheme of things, this small setback doesn't really matter.
cards.exUz: Umumiy reja bo'yicha, bu kichik muvaffaqiyatsizlik unchalik ahamiyatga ega emas.
cards.uzDef: Kattaroq reja yoki vaziyat nuqtai nazaridan.

cards.ex: Sometimes, you have to step back and look at the bigger picture.
cards.exUz: Ba'zida orqaga chekinib, kattaroq rasmga qarash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Umumiy vaziyat, asosiy maqsadi.

cards.ex: The room was decorated with understated elegance, creating a calming atmosphere.
cards.exUz: Xona oddiy nafislik bilan bezatilgan bo'lib, tinchlantiruvchi muhit yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, ammo juda chiroyli ko'rinish.

cards.ex: The risks of the surgery outweigh the potential benefits in his case.
cards.exUz: Uning holatida operatsiya xavflari potentsial foydadan ko'ra ko'proq.
cards.uzDef: Zarar foydadan ko'ra muhimroq yoki kattaroq bo'lishi.

cards.ex: We need to find sustainable solutions to address our dwindling resources.
cards.exUz: Kamayib borayotgan resurslarimizni hal qilish uchun barqaror yechimlarni topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud bo'lgan resurslar miqdorining kamayishi.

cards.ex: The small restaurant manages to hold its own against the larger chain restaurants.
cards.exUz: Kichik restoran yirik tarmoqli restoranlarga qarshi o'z o'rnini saqlab qolishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Raqobatga bardosh berish, o'z qadrini yo'qotmaslik.

cards.ex: These reported cases are just the tip of the iceberg; the real problem is much larger.
cards.exUz: Xabar qilingan bu holatlar aysbergning uchi xolos; haqiqiy muammo ancha katta.
cards.uzDef: Ko'rinadigan qismi katta muammoning kichik bir qismidir.

cards.ex: A significant portion of the budget is allocated to education.
cards.exUz: Byudjetning ancha qismi ta'limga ajratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Katta yoki muhim bo'lgan qismi.

cards.ex: Fees are determined on a sliding scale based on income.
cards.exUz: To'lovlar daromadga qarab o'zgaruvchan shkala bo'yicha belgilanadi.
cards.uzDef: Miqdor yoki narx o'zgaruvchan omillarga bog'liq holda o'zgaradi.

cards.ex: Their lifestyles are a world apart; she lives in the city, he lives in the countryside.
cards.exUz: Ularning turmush tarzi umuman boshqa olam; u shaharda yashaydi, u qishloqda yashaydi.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa juda farqli.

cards.ex: In stark contrast to her brother, she's very outgoing.
cards.exUz: Akasidan keskin farq qilib, u juda kirishimli.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasida katta va sezilarli farq.

cards.ex: The issue of climate change continues to loom large in global discussions.
cards.exUz: Iqlim o'zgarishi masalasi global muhokamalarda katta ta'sir ko'rsatishda davom etmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muhim yoki ta'sirli bo'lish.

cards.ex: The new law is an all-encompassing reform of the healthcare system.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun sog'liqni saqlash tizimining hammani qamrab oluvchi islohotidir.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani o'z ichiga olgan.

cards.ex: The new CEO implemented a sweeping change in company policy.
cards.exUz: Yangi bosh direktor kompaniya siyosatida katta o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Keng va muhim o'zgarish.

cards.ex: The storage tank had a cylindrical shape.
cards.exUz: Saqlash idishi silindr shakliga ega edi.
cards.uzDef: Silindrga o'xshash shakl.

cards.ex: The media coverage of the event was out of all proportion to its actual importance.
cards.exUz: Hodisaning ommaviy axborot vositalarida yoritilishi uning haqiqiy ahamiyatiga nisbatsiz edi.
cards.uzDef: O'lchov yoki qiymat bo'yicha noto'g'ri.

cards.ex: The city is now just a shadow of its former self, due to the economic crisis.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy inqiroz tufayli shahar endi avvalgi holatidan yomonroq.
cards.term: A shadow of its former self
cards.uzDef: Avval yaxshiroq bo'lgan, hozir esa yomon holatda.
